english: Huh, who's that over there...
Listen.\nWe can't afford\nto fail this mission.
Yeah. This mission -\nthe secret gets protected at all costs...
And if we fail...
We'll just have to silence them... ufufu.
(Ghk... silencing, desuu!?\nThis is serious, desuuu!)
Oh my, what are you doing here?
Sh-Shion-san!?
? Why are you so flustered?
Shion-san, n-no, desuu!!\nIt's dangerous here, desuu!\nRun away, desuu!!
Oh?\nToo bad - looks like we've been found out.
Well well,\nshall we do a little riko-rikoo...?
Now that you know the secret...
Can't let you go home alive...
Th-this really\ndoesn't look normal...\nI'll be making a strategic retreat.
W-wait! Shion!!
Sorry,\nbut nobody waits just because they're told to, sis.
R-run, desuu... Shion-san!?
Shut up! You - sleep.
Kyuuuuh!
Ufufu,\nlooks like nobody saw us after all.
Whether we were seen doesn't matter.
But...\njust because your snacking was about to be found out,\ndo you really have to go THIS far every time?
O-of course it does...\nShion, you're an accomplice too.
To carry out a mission in secret,\nsometimes cold decisions are necessary.
Well, if she still remembers when she wakes up,\nnext time for sure...
Huh... what\nwas I even doing here, desuu...?
I remember... Mion-san and Laura-sa...
